items.title: Preserve Python casing for traffic and IP filter operation groups
items.summary: Modify client-location augment decorators so Python uses PascalCase operation-group locations for listing associated traffic filters and creating/associating IP filters, while the existing lower-camel locations remain in effect for other targeted languages. The wire API is unchanged.

inferenceResults.rationale: The hunk keeps the existing lower-camel client locations for all previously targeted languages by adding Python to the exclusions, then adds Python-only PascalCase locations. It changes generated Python wrapper placement to preserve its established operation-group casing, without changing the REST contract or establishing a language-neutral public SDK break from the bounded evidence.

items.title: Preserve Python casing for private-link filter operation group
items.summary: Modify the private-link filter create-and-associate client location so Python uses the PascalCase operation-group location while non-Python generators retain the existing lower-camel location. The wire API is unchanged.

inferenceResults.rationale: The hunk preserves the existing lower-camel location for non-Python generators and adds a Python-only PascalCase location. This is a wrapper-compatibility mapping for Python casing; the bounded evidence supplies no REST change or language-neutral SDK contract change that warrants a candidate.
